paper.title: Impedance Adapting Compensation for Low-Power Multistage Amplifiers

recommended_controls.name: MOSFET_10_1_M_gm2_PMOS
recommended_controls.role: second-stage signal-device multiplicity; current and parasitics are coupled

recommended_controls.name: MOSFET_23_1_M_gm3_NMOS
recommended_controls.role: output-stage signal-device multiplicity; current and parasitics are coupled

recommended_controls.name: MOSFET_8_2_M_gm1_PMOS
recommended_controls.role: matched first-stage input-pair multiplicity; changes effective width, not a direct gm value

release.notes: Single outer Miller capacitor and series RC intermediate-node branch: CAPACITOR_1 net10 to net4, RESISTOR_0 net4 to ground; gmt-labelled device is second-stage cascode/current-source load, not an extra primary gain stage. AnalogGym paper Table6 reference numbers appear swapped for IAC and ACBC.

additional_source_informed_controls.name: RESISTOR_0
additional_source_informed_controls.role: series RC compensation resistance Ra; trades intermediate pole-zero placement against high parasitic pole

compensation_guidance.CAPACITOR_0: Cm outer Miller capacitor; extending upper bound above released 0.5pF is physically justified to reduce crossover if adapted model is unstable
compensation_guidance.CAPACITOR_1: Ca intermediate-node RC capacitor; require empirical pole separation, not independent monotone optimization
compensation_guidance.RESISTOR_0: Ra changes pnd2 approximately gm2*Ra*gm3/CL and pnd3 approximately 1/(Ra*C2); increasing Ra helps one pole but hurts another
compensation_guidance.paper_equations: 19,22,23,26,32,33; approximations presume large stage gains and compensation capacitances exceeding corresponding parasitics

release.schematic_visual_review_scope: AnalogGym released schematic only; original schematic review recorded separately in paper.review_level

adaptations: Netlist and original fixed parameter file copied unchanged.
Project-authored follower/AC testbench at 1.8 V, 27 C, SKY130 TT; released CLOAD/VCM retained.
Project-selected editable bounds and simulation-guided targets; no recovery of paper performance.
Large-signal settling uses a 20 mV absolute band for a 200 mV step (10%).
IAC Cm search range expanded to 0.125-10 pF and Ra exposed over 187.5 kohm-3 Mohm after source-equation review; the 60 degree phase-margin floor is unchanged.
